substances.name: Caffeine (Coffee)
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: Competitive A1/A2A adenosine receptor antagonism masks sleep pressure, prolongs sleep latency, and reduces Stage N3 slow-wave sleep.

substances.name: Caffeine (Energy Drink)
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: Rapid adenosine blockade combined with co-stimulants elevates sympathetic tone and delays deep NREM onset.

substances.name: Caffeine (Pre-Workout)
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: High-dose caffeine with adrenergic co-factors extends sleep latency and elevates nocturnal resting heart rate.

substances.name: Nicotine
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: Nicotinic acetylcholine activation triggers catecholamine surges, increasing micro-arousals and reducing REM stability.

substances.name: Adderall / Amphetamines
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: Sustained dopamine and norepinephrine release delays circadian sleep onset and sharply compresses REM and deep sleep.

substances.name: Modafinil
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: Long-acting dopamine reuptake inhibition and orexin activation suppress sleep drive for 12+ hours.

substances.name: Ritalin / Methylphenidate
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: DAT/NET blockade increases cortical arousal and fragments early NREM sleep cycles when dosed late.

substances.name: Alcohol
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: Initial GABAergic sedation triggers second-half REM suppression, glutamate rebound awakenings, and elevated nocturnal HR.

substances.name: Melatonin
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: MT1/MT2 circadian phase cue; low disruption, though mistimed or supraphysiologic doses can induce vivid dreams or grogginess.

substances.name: Diphenhydramine (Benadryl)
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: Central H1 and muscarinic blockade forces drowsiness while suppressing REM sleep and impairing restorative architecture.

substances.name: Cannabis (THC)
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: CB1 activation shortens sleep onset latency but dose-dependently suppresses REM sleep and alters slow-wave cycling.

substances.name: Cannabis (CBD)
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: Mild anxiolytic modulation with minimal disruption; very high doses can subtly shift REM timing.

substances.name: Heavy Late Meal
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: Postprandial thermogenesis and insulin spikes blunt the nocturnal core temperature drop required for deep N3 sleep.

substances.name: Corticosteroids
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: HPA-axis stimulation mimics acute cortisol elevation, fragmenting sleep continuity and reducing slow-wave sleep.

substances.name: Beta-Blockers
substances.sleepArchitectureEffect: Beta-1 blockade suppresses endogenous pineal melatonin release and can increase nocturnal awakenings or vivid dreams.
